d: Work is performed in the Anesthesia Services where staff provide anesthesia for elective and emergency surgery, obstetric and medical procedures as required in patients of all age groups from new born to the very elderly. The primary work area includes major and minor operating room plus the Anaesthesia work room.
Assists Anesthetist in OR, delivery suite, and in the Radiology Department for special procedures and in other areas where Anaesthesia or Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation is required.

Works with a wide variety of equipment peculiar to administration of anesthesia, patient monitoring and related life support systems and must be familiar with intravenous fluids plus fluid and blood administration systems. The position is closely supervised.
Adheres to professional ethics and medical by-laws of the kingdom.
q: Graduate of an accredited training program for anesthesia technicians. Current license certification in the kingdom.
Registered Nurse with current license or higher education
Two (2) years hospital clinical experience after graduation.
Fluent in verbal and written English.
Exhibits professionalism and excellent interpersonal communication skills.
r: Ensures through his actions, either directly or indirectly, that a superior quality of medical treatment, compassion and understanding is given to every patient served at the NMC Hospitals and Clinics.
Assists in all anesthesia procedures according to policy.
Audits the anesthetic equipment and materials to ensure that they are working
effectively and reports deficiencies immediately to the Anesthesiologist.
Reports faults in equipment or deficient supplies to the head of department or designate.
Interacts with other departments regarding non-clinical request i.e. inventory,
Prepares purchase requests for the department.
Must abide by department policies and procedures as well as hospital by-laws, rules and regulations within the Quality Program.
Assists Anesthetist with assembling in the O.R. or where required, supplies and equipment for administration of anesthesia and patient monitoring for elective and emergency surgery.
Assists during induction of anesthesia and tracheal incubation as well as during maintenance of and recovery from anesthesia.
Understands sequence of procedures required for rapid induction and incubation used in emergency cases to prevent vomiting and aspiration. Performs Sellick’s Maneuver (Cricoid Pressure) as required.
Positions patients for surgery and those requiring spinal or epidural anesthesia with awareness of requirement of a sterile field sterile technique for the procedure.
Draws blood via an arterial line as per written procedure or by direct venipuncture for blood gases or chemistry.
Between cases removes soiled material from Anaesthesia Machine and Anaesthesia Cart and replaces same with clean or sterile material as required.
Maintains Anaesthesia Machine in state of readiness by keeping adequate fresh supplies available.
Changes soda lime and compressed gas cylinder as required.
Replaces EKG electrodes, breathing circuits and suction apparatus after each case.
Learns and keeps current with the names of equipment, supplies and pharmacological agents and is familiar with location of same.
Assists Anesthetist with starting I.V. infusion.
Cleans at end of day individual anesthesia carts and anesthesia work room and ensures that work room is left neat and well organized for the following day.
Understands procedures used and assists with C.P.R. in the O.R.
Receives delivery of supplies and pharmaceuticals and stores them in proper location.
Performs general cleaning of anesthesia machine, monitoring equipment and storage spaces.
Checks anesthesia machine every morning prior to surgery to ensure that the gas
Scavenging system is attached and the suction apparatus is attached and functioning.
Attaches monitoring devises such as EKG electrodes, B.P. cuff and temperature probe to patient prior to anesthesia.
Shares “on-call” rotation to provide assistance for emergency surgeries during other than normal working hours, i.e. nights, week ends, and holidays.
Knows how to set-up, calibrate and operate all anesthesia equipment and monitors.
Maintains awareness of safety hazards and takes necessary action to prevent accidents.
Attends monthly staff meetings and daily morning communication meeting
Maintains confidentiality of patient records and activities in the O.R.
Participates in fire and disaster plan drills.
Performs other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of the employee’s knowledge, skills and abilities.

d: We are currently looking for a passionate, proactive, and technically skilled Engineering professional who takes pride in maintaining the highest standards of safety, reliability, and operational efficiency while supporting an exceptional guest experience.

As a Duty Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the hotel’s mechanical, electrical, HVAC, and technical systems. You will oversee maintenance activities, respond to operational requirements, and lead the Engineering team on duty to ensure that equipment and facilities remain safe, reliable, and well maintained at all times.
q: You should ideally hold a degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, with previous experience in a similar role, preferably within the hotel or hospitality industry.

You should have solid technical knowledge of the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of mechanical, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and other building systems and equipment. The ability to diagnose faults, identify root causes, and carry out or coordinate effective corrective action is essential.

A good command of English, both written and spoken, is required, together with strong technical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Previous experience in supervising an Engineering or Maintenance team will be an advantage.
The ideal candidate will be a self-motivated, hands-on, and technically capable professional with a proactive, reliable, and flexible approach to work.

You should be able to adapt quickly to unexpected technical and operational challenges, prioritize maintenance requirements effectively, and remain calm and solution-focused under pressure. Strong attention to detail, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead and support the Engineering team are essential for success in this role.
You should possess the following key competencies
r: Supervise and coordinate the hotel’s preventive and corrective maintenance activities , ensuring work is completed efficiently and to the required standards.
Monitor the operation and maintenance of HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other technical systems and equipment .
Ensure the preventive maintenance schedule is strictly followed and that accurate maintenance records are maintained for future reference.
Conduct regular inspections of equipment, plant rooms, and hotel facilities to identify potential issues and ensure timely corrective action.
Support and maintain high standards of health, safety, fire safety, and operational compliance across the property.
Respond promptly to technical issues and emergency maintenance requirements to minimize disruption to guests and hotel operations.
Coordinate closely with other departments to understand their maintenance requirements and ensure satisfaction with the quality and timely completion of work .
Assign and distribute daily tasks to Engineering team members according to their skills, capabilities, and operational priorities .
Supervise work performed by the team and ensure repairs and maintenance activities meet the hotel’s required standards.
Support the development and delivery of departmental training programmes , encouraging team members to develop technical knowledge and multi-skilling capabilities.
Monitor the proper use of tools, equipment, materials, and spare parts while helping to control wastage and maintenance costs.
Maintain clear communication with the Engineering leadership team regarding technical concerns, pending repairs, emergencies, and operational priorities .
Lead by example and contribute to a safe, efficient, reliable, and guest-focused Engineering operation .

q: Diploma or Technical Certificate in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Basic knowledge of fiber optic technology, splicing, and testing equipment.
Ability to read technical drawings and troubleshoot network issues.
Strong attention to detail, teamwork, and communication skills.
Ability to work outdoors, at heights, and in confined spaces when required.
Valid driving license is an advantage.
0-2 years of experience in fiber optics, telecommunications, or a related field.
Preferred certifications: Fiber Optic Technician (FOT) and OTDR & Power Meter Testing Certification.
r: Assist in fiber optic cable splicing, termination, restoration, and testing activities.
Perform fiber tracing, cable identification, and continuity testing.
Support network troubleshooting using OTDR, power meters, and related test equipment.
Read and interpret network drawings, cable routes, and splice schematics.
Maintain splice closures, patch panels, and distribution cabinets.
Record splicing activities and test results accurately.
Support preventive maintenance and emergency fault restoration works.
Ensure compliance with company HSE standards and procedures.
